p.title: v59.98 A published FOMC brief with a non-Korean headline is repaired
p.symptom: An FOMC brief stored before v59.97 with an English headline kept it on every later refresh.
p.root_cause: safeHeadline guards only new FOMC briefs; the stored-brief repair pass in fetch-event-briefs.mjs covered earnings briefs only.
p.fix: The repair pass gives a stored FOMC brief whose headline fails isKoreanHeadline the producer's dated fallback line (fomcFallbackHeadline, the same one new briefs use), without an AI call; a Korean headline is untouched.
p.violated_rule: Korean UI: a stored headline meets the same gate as a new one.
p.prevention: ci-event-briefs-check drives buildEventBriefs with a previous artifact holding an English and a Korean FOMC headline (AI source throws if called).
p.verification: The English case failed before the fix and passes after; node scripts/ci-event-briefs-check.mjs exits 0.

changelog: **저장된 FOMC 요약 제목 ({P}):** 이미 발행된 FOMC 요약의 제목이 한국어가 아니면, 다음 갱신 때 AI 호출 없이 '10/28 FOMC 결정' 형식의 날짜 제목으로 바꾼다.
